info.name: EliteGate Complete Multi-Tenant & Dedicated Gateway Testing Plan
info.description: Comprehensive Postman test collection for validating both Shared Gateway (RLS + multi-tenancy) and Dedicated Gateway deployment patterns in EliteGate.

item.name: 1. Tenant Isolation Tests
item.description: Validates basic tenant scoping and cross-tenant access restriction checks.

request.description:
Purpose: Authenticates user and retrieves admin JWT token.
Method: POST
URL: {{admin_url}}/admin/login
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: username/password
Expected Response: 200 OK with token.
Postman Tests: Extracts jwt token.
Variables Created: jwt

Purpose: Retrieves routes belonging to Alpha Project.
Method: GET
URL: {{admin_url}}/admin/v1/projects/{{alpha_project_id}}/routes
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}
Expected Response: 200 OK with list.
Variables Consumed: jwt, alpha_project_id

Purpose: Attempts to fetch Beta routes without project membership mapping.
Method: GET
URL: {{admin_url}}/admin/v1/projects/{{beta_project_id}}/routes
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}
Expected Response: 403 Forbidden.
Variables Consumed: jwt, beta_project_id

Purpose: Registers a route under Alpha Project context.
Method: POST
URL: {{admin_url}}/admin/v1/projects/{{alpha_project_id}}/routes
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}, Content-Type: application/json
Expected Response: 201 Created.
Variables Consumed: jwt, alpha_project_id

item.name: Verify Beta Cannot See Alpha Routes

request.description:
Purpose: Validates that Project Beta cannot view routes from Project Alpha.
Method: GET
URL: {{admin_url}}/admin/v1/projects/{{beta_project_id}}/routes
Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}
Expected Response: 403 Forbidden.
Variables Consumed: jwt, beta_project_id
